CommunityApplications.Profile:
Self-hosted tooling for people who buy from overseas marketplaces.
**Shopping Hub** crawls AliExpress, Alibaba, DHgate, Banggood, Made-in-China, Geekbuying, Chinavasion and eBay, works out which listings are the *same physical product*, and gives you one page per product with every site's price, minimum order quantity and disclosed shipping - translated to English.
It compares on **landed cost** (unit price x MOQ + freight + duty) rather than sticker price, because the cheapest unit price routinely belongs to the most expensive order. A US retail baseline from eBay is included so it can tell you when importing is not actually worth it.
Issues and questions are handled on GitHub.
